title: Penalty for signing false document.
bodyText:
(a) A person commits an offense by signing a document the person knows is false in any material respect with intent that the document be delivered to the department director for filing.

(b) An offense under this section is a class C felony.
bodyHtml:
[§414D-12]  Penalty for signing false document.  (a)  A person commits an offense by signing a document the person knows is false in any material respect with intent that the document be delivered to the department director for filing.

     (b)  An offense under this section is a class C felony. [L 2001, c 105, pt of §1]
